evals.prompt: I want to review PR 482 myself. Open it so I can ask questions.
evals.expected_output: The PR checked out in its own worktree and a Plannotator session open on it, with the user's annotations answered from the code.
expectations: Checks the PR's head out into its own worktree through use-worktrees
Runs plannotator review with the PR URL from that worktree, in the background
Answers each annotation from the worktree's code with file:line
Posts nothing to GitHub without approval of the exact text

evals.prompt: The change is finished and its checks pass.
evals.expected_output: An offer to review the change in Plannotator, with no session opened until the user agrees.
expectations: Offers a Plannotator review of the change
Does not run plannotator before the user agrees

evals.prompt: Yes, open my changes in Plannotator.
evals.expected_output: plannotator review run from the repository root, and its decision followed.
expectations: Runs plannotator review from the repository root in the background
Does not treat an approved review as approval to commit, push or open a PR
